Author: dajoey
Name: LazyRetainerLive
Description: Serves the logged-in character's live retainer and venture state on loopback HTTP (127.0.0.1:10504) so the ffxiv dashboard relay can show real-time venture countdowns instead of AutoRetainer's occasionally-stale file cache.
Punchline: Real-time retainer venture countdowns for your dashboard.
Changelog:
v0.1.0.8 (2026-11-16) [testing]
- Fixed the local listener spinning a CPU core after the port changed; the port now applies when Enter is pressed.

v0.1.0.7 (2026-11-15) [testing]
- The window was polished for the real in-game font and scale: text no longer clips or sits against card borders.
- Endpoint and continuity values sit in one aligned column and no longer break letter by letter; requirement rows keep a fixed pitch with the status word on the right in its state colour.
- Stat cards show larger values at equal heights, with a progress track only on cards that have a real ratio, and collapse to compact cards at narrow widths.
- The window body is a single scroll area with a soft fade at the bottom and thin scrollbars, and columns end at the same height.
- The header has a bordered brand chip, a fixed-width neutral status pill and a close button with a small tooltip beneath it; the Stop listener button sizes to its label with a red outline and dims when the listener is already off.

v0.1.0.6 (2026-11-15) [testing]
- The settings window has a custom close button in the header, next to the state pill, that closes the window directly. The outer window scrollbar is removed; the body and the wide columns keep their own scrolling, so every card and setting stays reachable at narrow sizes while the footer and the Stop listener button remain in view.

v0.1.0.5 (2026-11-15) [testing]
- The settings window has a new card-based layout: a custom header with a live state pill, summary cards for retainers, active ventures and free inventory slots, and cards for the loopback endpoint, snapshot continuity, requirements and settings. The layout wraps responsively at narrow and wide window sizes, and the body scrolls.
- The window no longer has a native title bar. A footer pinned to the bottom shows the current listener state and keeps the "Stop listener" button reachable at every size.
- Listener state, retainer details, inventory, venture progress and endpoint information are all taken from the live snapshot and listener status. Saved settings, the listener, automatic port rebinding, commands, Lazy Hub controls and the HTTP response format are unchanged.

v0.1.0.4 (2026-11-14) [testing]
- The plugin windows have been rebuilt on the shared LalaUiKit: one consistent layout with themed section headers, unified spacing and colour accents. All settings and behaviour are unchanged, and existing configuration loads as-is.

v0.1.0.3 (2026-11-10) [testing]
- Rebuilt against the Dalamud 15.0.4.0 payload for game patch 7.58. No functional changes.
